name: Weariness
overview: Scripture reveals that weariness is a human condition met with God's unfailing strength and restoration. While the everlasting God never grows weary or faint, He empowers the weak and renews the strength of those who wait on Him, enabling them to rise above fatigue and continue in faithful service. Christ invites all who are burdened and weary to come to Him for rest, assuring that perseverance in doing good will ultimately bring a harvest if one does not give up. God's promise to satisfy the weary soul underscores His compassionate provision for those who struggle under life's burdens.
